profile_text.body:
Credo AI, founded in 2020, describes itself as the trusted leader in AI governance. The company's platform enables enterprises to discover AI systems, enforce policies, prove compliance, and manage risk across models, agents, and applications. According to its site, Credo AI created the AI governance category and is now defining it for the agentic era, powered by a Knowledge Graph that fuses global regulatory intelligence with business context.

The company offers the Credo AI platform, a purpose-built AI governance system featuring policy packs for the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and other standards. The platform includes GAIA (Govern AI Assistant), which the company says compresses weeks of governance work into hours. Credo AI emphasizes agent governance as a core capability, offering registry, risk assessment, and controls for agents as first-class governed entities alongside models and applications. The platform integrates natively across existing stacks and includes over 300 integrations.

The site highlights customer testimonials from organizations including Mastercard, IBM, and others in insurance, financial services, federal, and healthcare sectors. One customer reports that Credo AI accelerated EU AI Act compliance by at least 10x compared to manual approaches. The company's policy packs are written by team members involved in standards development at ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and the OECD.
